title: Energy-performance tradeoffs in server farms with batch services and setup times
summary: Data centers consume a large amount of energy, much of which is wasted due to idle servers. Turning off idle servers might be an effective power-saving solution; however, there is a trade-off between energy savings and system performance. Hence, we propose a setup queueing model with a batching policy that allows servers to process a set of jobs simultaneously to minimize power consumption while maintaining acceptable performance.
